text:
sara_support: cc @ryan_billing @andy_eng — customer 'OrgCorp BR' reported a promo code (WELCOME50) not applying on checkout. They say UI shows discount, but invoice and backend apply no credit. Case #BR-1182.
sara_support: steps from customer: 1) select plan (monthly, BRL) 2) enter promo `WELCOME50` 3) UI shows -R$14.50 but final charge is full amount. They attached screenshot and invoice PDF.
sara_support: pasted the backend error we see when trying to apply the promo via API:```json
{
  "promo_apply_result": "rejected",
  "reason_code": "PROMO_INELIGIBLE_AFTER_TAX",
  "details": "subtotal_after_tax (R$0.00) < promo_min_subtotal (R$1.00) due to tax rounding"
}
```
sara_support: looks like tax rounding / inclusive pricing edge-case for BR locale. Customer expects free-trial grant to zero-out the first invoice.
ryan_billing: thanks. can you attach the full invoice JSON (billing export) + the plan price + country/currency? I want to see pre-tax subtotal and tax breaks.
sara_support: attached minimal invoice JSON in ticket (id attached). plan_price = R$29.00, tax rate = 18% (local service tax), promo configured to require min_subtotal_before_tax = R$1.00. In our apply flow we currently check `subtotal - promo_amount - tax` vs min_subtotal.
andy_eng: quick thought: are we treating taxes as included in displayed price for BR? If UI shows discount but backend calculates tax on post-promo amount, rounding could push taxable amount to 0.00 and our guard rejects promo since it sees effective subtotal below threshold.
andy_eng: repro attempt on staging: applied `WELCOME50` to a plan priced at R$29.00 with 18% tax. UI preview shows discount R$14.50 and tax R$5.22 (rounded), final R$19.72. But the eligibility check runs on cents after tax rounding and hits `subtotal_after_tax < promo_min_subtotal` for some rounding orders.
priya_legal: flagging that Brazil rules require taxes shown/included in certain invoices depending on service classification. We should be careful altering billing math without confirming compliance.
ryan_billing: +1 on not changing semantics blindly. Short-term: can we offer the customer a manual credit for the first invoice and fix promo logic next patch?
sara_support: customer asked for immediate resolution — they want the free trial applied now. I offered credit as a workaround if billing approves.
andy_eng: propose fix: evaluate promo eligibility on pre-tax subtotal (as stored) and separate the display calculation. If promo_min_subtotal is defined, check against `pre_tax_subtotal - promo_amount >= min` instead of post-tax. That avoids rounding-cross zero. I'll put a PR for the billing service.
andy_eng: also adding unit tests for BR/CL/AR locales where tax rounding rules differ.
ryan_billing: ok please include audit logs for any retro credits. Priya: will you confirm legal okay with how we display line items if we change evaluation order?
priya_legal: will review PR notes once Andy posts them. No objections to changing eligibility check as long as invoice presentation still meets local regs.
ops_bot: Ticket BR-1182 created and assigned to ryan_billing, andy_eng. SLA: 48h.
sara_support: action items: (1) ryan to approve manual credit for BR-1182 if legal ok, (2) andy to open PR and tests, target patch in next deploy, (3) sara to notify customer and apply manual credit if approved.
ryan_billing: approved provisional credit pending priya sign-off. pls draft short note for finance.
sara_support: will draft note and update ticket. thanks team :thumbsup:
andy_eng: if anyone needs my repro script:```bash
# repro script (staging)
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/apply \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' \
  -d '{"plan_price_cents":2900,"tax_rate":0.18,"promo_code":"WELCOME50","currency":"BRL"}'
```
sara_support: filing follow-up in ticket. last update here then closing thread.
